title: Choose RandomChatly's love-themed world
question: Fresh hand. The roll assigned String Lights. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again. Fonts stay Outfit + Plus Jakarta Sans.

options.label: String Lights
options.lineage: a bedroom wall at night: photos pinned along a string of warm fairy lights
options.thesis: The people you keep end up on your wall. Every match is a new light on the string.
options.viewport: Match tab: a thin string drapes across the top third with small warm bulbs; while searching the bulbs light one by one along the string; when matched a new photo frame clips onto it. Warm coral 'Find a Match' pill in thumb reach.
options.risk: Fairy lights can tip into cosy-cute or a lamplight glow; bulbs stay flat dots and frames stay crisp.

raised.raise: No ornament beyond the string: flat surfaces and generous empty wall.
Each tab owns one hue on its section header only (Match, Friends, Discover), never splashed across content.
The action colour is reserved for actions and nothing else.
One alert colour, used only when something changes (new message, request).

options.label: Late-Night Cinema
options.lineage: a late show for two: velvet seats, the screen's light on faces
options.thesis: Two strangers in the dark, sharing the same screen.
options.viewport: Match tab: a wide 'screen' rectangle at the top; searching, a countdown leader runs on it; matched, the screen lights with the stranger's name like an opening title.
options.risk: Familiar: wine-and-gold reads like many date-night brands.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Everyone you meet is a star; the ones you keep draw your constellation.
materials: red-flashlight ring for the live one
options.viewport: Match tab: a quiet star field; searching, faint stars twinkle; matched, a line draws from your star to theirs.
options.case: Stargazing is romantic and widely loved; loses some clarity because a chart is abstract for chat.
options.risk: Blue night ground sits close to the radio theme you moved away from.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft, warm and obvious: every control says plainly what it does.
options.viewport: Match tab: warm light ground, one large friendly card with your avatar, rose 'Find a Match' button.
options.case: Very clear to use; weaker on romance and on the late-night-in-bed scene (it is a light theme).

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.case: About letterforms, not people; conflicts with pinned fonts.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.case: Technical manual tone; wrong for romance.
options.kept: One hue per section, on headers only.

options.label: Airport Yellow Signs
options.case: Loud public signage; the opposite of intimate.
options.kept: Action colour reserved for action only.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.kept: One alert colour for changes only.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A mainstream dating app look, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: White screen, big profile card, coral heart button.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every dating app, and reads swipe-first rather than chat-first.
